{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#FLUX --time=20:30:00
#FLUX --nodes=1
#FLUX --gpus=1 # The 'xk' node type implies a GPU is needed
#FLUX --ntasks-per-node=1
#FLUX --cpus-per-task=16
#FLUX --job-name=final.OneEmbModel_resnet50

# NOTE: The PBS resource 'gres=shifter' was omitted as it is site-specific and
# does not have a direct equivalent in Flux.

# The Flux equivalent of PBS_O_WORKDIR is FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR
cd ${FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR}

module load shifter

shifterimg pull luntlab/cs547_project:latest

#RESUME_ARGS="--run_id 33iy6q8g --resume"
RESUME_ARGS=""
MODEL_ARGS="--model OneEmbModel_resnet18 "

WANDB_RUN_ID=${FLUX_JOB_ID}

export OMP_NUM_THREADS=16
# 'aprun' is a Cray-specific launcher. It has been replaced with a direct call
# to 'shifter'. The resource specifications from aprun are now job-level directives.
shifter --image=docker:luntlab/cs547_project:latest \
    --module=mpich,gpu -- python src/train_main.py -v \
    ${RESUME_ARGS} \
    --wandb_tags debug,bw,final,finalfinal --epochs 1000 ${MODEL_ARGS} \
    --loss default --lr 0.0005 --margin 2.0 --batch_size 200
"
}
